subject: Important Update: Your upcoming flight details
body: Dear [Recipient], We wanted to inform you that there has been a slight change in your upcoming flight details. The departure time has been adjusted to accommodate air traffic conditions. Your new departure time is now scheduled for [new time]. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Best regards, The Airline Team
